item.text: The defect is isolated to the shared note sorter: it assigns pinned notes after unpinned notes. Reversing that single comparison preserves each group’s existing newest-first timestamp order; because pinning updates only the selected note’s timestamp, the newly pinned note naturally becomes the first pinned item.
